title: debpalash/OmniVoice-Studio

zh.gap: 所有商业对手都是要你把自己的声音传上去的云订阅，而声音恰恰是人们最不愿意交出去的那件东西——这也是大量潜在用户从来没开始过的原因。
zh.pain: 有一柜子没人会去录的文字、或者一段没人会去配音的视频的人——他既不会花钱进棚，也不会去学一套工具。
zh.kill: 声音克隆是这个目录里最容易被滥用的一项能力；如果不对参考音源做硬性授权门槛，最积极的早期用户会是错的那批人。
zh.move: 只挑那个既明确是成品、又明确属于用户自己的输出：我自己的书，用我自己的声音读出来，存成我自己的文件。直接拒绝第三方参考音。冷启动：中文＝豆瓣/小红书「有声书 自制」与独立作者群；英文＝r/selfpublish 里长年不断的有声书成本吐槽（ACX 报价）。

pick_reason: Genuinely differentiated local product — 646-language zero-shot cloning and end-to-end offline dubbing over a 14-engine hub, and MCP-drivable.
gap: Every commercial equivalent is a cloud subscription that requires uploading your voice, which is exactly the asset people are least willing to hand over — and the reason a huge fraction of would-be users never start.
pain: The person with a shelf of writing nobody will ever record, or a video nobody will ever dub — who is not going to pay a studio and is not going to learn one.
kill: Voice cloning is the single most abuse-prone capability in this catalogue; without hard consent gating on the reference voice, the product's most enthusiastic early users will be the wrong ones.
move: Pick the one output that is unambiguously a finished artifact and unambiguously the user's own: my own book, read in my own voice, as a file I keep. Refuse third-party reference voices outright. Cold start CN = 豆瓣/小红书「有声书 自制」与独立作者群; EN = r/selfpublish audiobook-cost threads (ACX pricing complaints are a standing genre).
